prompt: Use case: art-direction paintover for a stylized open-world game. Image 1 is an in-game screenshot. Keep its camera, horizon, field of view, terrain, buildings and every object exactly where they are. Image 2 is the game's art direction: keep its soft, painterly style, warm light and palette. This view is from the roll-in tower of the skate ramps at the volcano's crater rim, inside a lenticular cap cloud that sits on the summit. Paint the ramps as warm wooden skate ramps. Around the rider the cloud is a thin, luminous, translucent haze: the ramps and nearby rock are crisp, and the world beyond (the valley, the distant town of Belmonte, forests and sea) is still visible but softly blurred and veiled, as if seen through frosted glass, with bright sunlit wisps and layered cloud lenses curving overhead and below the rim. Dreamy, airy, high-altitude mood, but still clear enough to skate. No text, no UI.
